title: Yellow Mellow Ethiopian Lamb Stew
description: A malty and romantic Ethiopian dish featuring lamb stock, cooked to perfection in a bain-marie on a tava-griddle, with a low-calorie friendly twist.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the tava-griddle over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the berbere spice, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the lamb stock and tomato paste, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours.
Remove the cover and continue to simmer for an additional 30 minutes, or until the lamb is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
